title: Known substructures and the June event: Sagittarius, the Gaia Sausage, S1/S2 and the Helmi streams as sources of a 248 keV recoil
question: Using recalled Gaia-era kinematics of Sagittarius, the Gaia Sausage, S1, S2, Helmi streams and retrograde shards, what are their Earth-frame speeds through the year (own modulation phase/amplitude), delta_max(248 keV), composite inelastic rate boosts at delta = 250-380 keV, June/December ratios, the 16 June date likelihood ratio, and their directional signature?
headline_result: No known Gaia substructure reaches v_lab = 700 km/s: each is a pure (1-f) deficit (0.80-0.99) for delta >= 300 keV, leaves the 16 June date LR (1.46/2.45/3.10 at 300/350/380 keV) unchanged to 0.6 %, and the June-14-phased Sgr(+W) and Helmi(+W) are 400-550 km/s too slow; P030's rescuing 1 % v_esc stream boosts the rate x47 but lowers LR x0.76-0.88; only Sagittarius would be directionally distinguishable (46-57 deg off the wind)
key_numbers: v_E(16 Jun)=265.96 km/s (wimprates 265.98; from-scratch frame agrees to 0.08 km/s); v_lab Sgr 387/415, S1 565, shards 556, S2 253, Helmi 259-292; peak day SHM 152.5 (amp 14.5), Sgr+W 165.3 (29.3), Helmi+W 166.3 (29.5), S1 159.3 (11.1), shards 155.7; delta_max <= 231 keV (+2sigma_par), <= 348 (6sigma edge) vs 387; composite/SHM delta>=300: Sgr 0.970, GSE 0.800, S1 0.900 (pure 0.9 ev vs 1154), shards 0.990; LR SHM 1.276/1.455/1.877/2.451/2.857/3.101 (250-380), composites x1.000 (>=300), x0.998-1.006 (250); v_esc stream f=1%: rate x3.7/28/47, LR x0.76/0.86/0.88; Sausage eta ratio 0.814/0.801/0.800 at 650/700/750, June/Dec 2.5418->2.5425, elastic a1 +7/+12/+17% at 10/50/248 keV; direction: arrival cone 12 deg + recoil 8.5 deg (d=380) about (l,b)=(268,+4); Sgr arrival b=-47/+50, 7 deg cone, elastic 248 keV level +2.8%
model_or_mechanism: v_esc-truncated anisotropic Gaussian substructures in the Galactic frame (SHM++ Sausage beta=0.9), numerically boosted to the Earth frame with a J2000 ecliptic->Galactic Earth-velocity vector; composite (1-f) SHM + f; WimPyDD O1 per-stream kernels (1 TeV, Higgsino coupling); P006 run-window date LR; first-harmonic phase fits; density-weighted arrival directions
confidence: medium: construction validated (eta to 1e-4, rates 1-6 % vs WimPyDD, Earth velocity 0.08 km/s) but all substructure kinematics and fractions are recalled
agent_tools: Read x17, Bash x10, Write x5, Edit x18, Skill x1 (dataviz), ToolSearch x1, TaskStop x1
software_and_packages: python 3.12.13; numpy 2.5.3; scipy 1.18.1; pandas 3.0.5; matplotlib 3.11.2; WimPyDD 2.0.4 (diff_rate per-stream kernels, v_earth_sun); wimprates 0.5.0 (earth_velocity validation); numericalunits 1.28; common/lzcommon.py
local_inputs: PAPER_GUIDE; dossier; ledger; P002/P006/P007/P018/P030/P034 papers; P030_streams.py + known_substructures.csv; P006_event_date.py + P006_summary.json; lzcommon.py; ENVIRONMENT_versions
recalled_knowledge: 13: J2000 eq->Gal matrix, obliquity, orbital speed (certain); 2023 equinox, LLS e1/e2, SHM++ Sausage construction, Sgr/S1/Helmi velocities (likely); Sgr sign/f, S1 U-sign/f, S2, shards (uncertain); G_F, sin2thetaW (certain)
